name: 3D Assets Manifest
description: Registry of all 3D food models, ad textures, and holographic assets stored on the Synology NAS. Synced from this repo via the GitHub Actions sync-to-nas workflow.

/volume1/assets/3d-assets/models/food.description: GLTF/GLB 3D food models for Yellow Pages restaurant ad rotations.

/volume1/assets/3d-assets/textures/ads.description: Flat ad textures (PNG/WebP) mapped onto billboard planes in WebGL.

/volume1/assets/3d-assets/textures/holog.description: Transparent RGBA textures for holographic overlay renders (spectral veil integration).

/volume1/assets/3d-assets/textures/video.description: Video textures (looping mp4/webm) for animated ad slots.

/volume1/assets/3d-assets/hdri.description: HDRI environment maps for 3D ad lighting.

assetRegistry.description: Live registry of assets — add entries here when uploading to the NAS.

adSequencerMapping.description: Maps NAS asset paths to AdAsset.assetPath values expected by ad-sequencer.tool.ts.
